about: One row per entry of the LM coverage map (acceptance point 2: every major mode and routine the program uses). status is mapped (scenarios names the tools/flight_host_differential.py FLIGHT entries that run it), not exercised (note gives the reason) or TBD. Rows start from the auditor draft (/mnt/project-files/steward/coverage-map.md, 10-18) with Lane F corrections (luminary099-coverage-map.md sections 3, 6, 7). Each lane edits its own rows; tools/program_acceptance.py lm turns this into docs/acceptance/Luminary099-integrated_program_tests.md. A mapped row's windows lists the replay windows that run the row ([scenario, start cs], or [scenario, start cs, cs, K] for a chain) (its event falls inside the window); only those windows give the row its C64 credit. replay_windows lists the C64 --replay windows (scenario, start cs, length cs) the doc is made from; each mapped scenario has at least one, at most 1000 cs so the replay rows fit below the rope. A mapped row may name its body in reach ([[point, label], ...], a point as the host reports print it): the host run must reach each (FLIGHT_REACH), so a scenario that only takes the entry's refusal does not count. Every mapped extended-verb and R-routine row whose entry can refuse (TESTXACT, CHKPOOH, CKMODCAD, OP/INERT, RDRUSECK, the update program's MODREG check, TRMTRACK's flag test) names the routine or job past those checks (Lane F audit, 10-23; uplink rows name their own UPEND70-73); rows whose entry only sets or clears a flag (V57, V58, V61, V62, V65, V66, V74-V77, V80, V81, V93, V95, V96) name that entry, program rows name the program's own entry (run only once V37 accepts it; P70/P71 past LEGAL?), other R rows the first basic word of the routine, and V97/V99 the program's paste of the flash. Program flashes with no paste of their own (GOLOADLV: V50, V52-V54) name why in no_reach instead (#805 item 2). A point two rows share in one scenario takes a third field, the centisecond this row's body runs from; the host run reports every arrival.

VERB69 is TC VERB69 (EXTENDED_VERBS.agc:81), a TC to itself: the AGC's TC trap restarts it. The host differential runs under scaled time, where the bridge stops at a TC to itself, so no FLIGHT scenario runs it. The restart checks do (docs/FLIGHT-RESTART.md, A2's recovery_and_restart rows): lm-v69-restart on the host, unscaled (yaAGC's trap at 25.01 s, 4,000 of 4,000 samples equal, back to P00), and the C64 lm-v69 window from 2300 cs, which matches the host up to the trap (Lane F, 10-23).
